title: IR 3.1 and the compiler on IR 3

findings.claim: The lake carries no result reference range (no range column in lake/flatten.py, no measurement.range_high from the OMOP load), so value.ref decides from the signed site table in the SQL; the CQL refuses value.ref (no_cql_reference_range).
No signed site reference-range table exists and none is passed to build_artifacts; every value.ref criterion is unknown with no_reference_range until both exist.
No caller supplies study anchor dates (criterion_anchors in SQL, ScreeningDate/RandomizationDate in CQL); a per-patient CQL parameter is not verified.

Medication dose compiles in SQL only (quantity per exposure; FHIR carries a dose per administration); route is refused in both engines (no_route_mapping) until a SNOMED to OMOP route table exists. The representation needs a ruling.
no_reference_range is not in tb_common.labunit.TOKENS, so reason_of reads it as a record reference.
SQL against CQL equivalence of the new IR 3 constructs on executed engines is not run (needs the FHIR store); text, DuckDB and translator checks only.
